title: iPRA by first-instance witness discharge
positive_claims: Complete native specification: scalar computation normal forms, Eq/D formulas, one fixed reflexivity clause, three inference families.
Two-premise Name has no independently supplied equality proof or replacement term.
Exact open-sequent equivalence with unrestricted witness discharge, with identity end sequents.
Direct raw/canonical consequence equivalence and both formula and clause composites.
Full first-order iPRA bi-interpretability, whole numerical domains, actual equality, identity numerical graphs.
Equiconsistency, with designated contradiction 0=S0 preserved in both directions.
Optional fuel-bounded certificate predicate is primitive recursive and has the same theorem set.
Selected complete module: 2157 normalized bytes, 704 significant tokens, 804 AST nodes, 870 gzip9 bytes.
Matched old-rule control: 2228 normalized bytes, 701 tokens, 813 AST nodes, 894 gzip9 bytes.
limits: No absolute simplest-presentation or global checker-size optimality theorem.
The repository compact 516-byte and native public-goal 788-byte profiles are not beaten.
The matched reduction trades three additional tokens for 71 fewer bytes and nine fewer AST nodes.
No new Lean/Rocq formalization of the universal metatheorems.
Finite tests support the implementations and proof translations, not their universal correctness.
Full normalization is external computation; no object-level uniform evaluator or totality axiom is added.
Physical interpreter stack, parser and memory limits may reject large finite certificates.
inherited_material: Scalar iteration and the D logical basis
Full normalization and zero-witness case repair
Two-row naming method, with rows changed for the new deterministic restriction
Scalar predecessor, equality reflection, pairing and the primitive-recursive compiler
